seo.title: A 3,400-year-old royal secret hidden in clay tablets
seo.description:
Archaeologists uncovered 131 cuneiform tablets revealing a deadly epidemic and a nursing princess who died during King Tudhaliya II's reign. This royal tragedy remained buried in the ancient archive for 3,400 years.

#AncientHistory #Archaeology #HistoryUncovered #Cuneiform

Sources:
